risks.risk: Q07-ENRICHED-ROLE returns 10 UNRESOLVED_PHYSICAL_SERVICE rows, not the predicted 4
risks.detail: SOURCE_CONTRACT.md counts operating capacity only on a physical base representative, which requires marketing and operating to resolve to the same airline. CAP block 0 was made base metal so the operating clock counts 8 markets and 14 of the 18 rows carry capacity. CLK 04..07 and CLK 10..11 cannot be made base metal without creating Q06 market entries and exits at pair 23, which would break Q06-ENRICHED at 7 and 5, so their 6 rows are unresolved. Under the specification's literal CAP construction the operating clock would have counted nothing at all.
risks.action_for_the_caller: Accept 8 counted plus 10 unresolved, or add an always-present cohort holding the CLK operating markets open, which changes the row budget.
